title: Generosity
definition: Generosity is the cheerful, sacrificial sharing of what God has entrusted for the good of others and the glory of Christ.
summary: Generosity is open-handed stewardship of resources, time, attention, and care for the glory of God and good of others.
christFocus: Jesus Christ became poor for our sake, and His grace teaches His people to give freely.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content: This doctrine focuses on the posture of giving. Generosity flows from trust that God is provider and from joy in His grace. It is broader than money, reaching hospitality, mercy, encouragement, opportunity, and shared burdens.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: This matters because fear and selfishness make the heart close its hand. Generosity witnesses that treasure is in God, not possessions. It also becomes a practical way Christ's love reaches real needs.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Practice giving in specific, planned, and spontaneous ways. Ask what you are holding too tightly. Let generosity include presence, listening, service, and material help.
